data-layer-patterns-edho-ferdian.description: Agent form of the data-layer-patterns-edho-ferdian skill, same triggers — delegate here when the task justifies isolated or parallel execution; a small task should use the skill directly instead. Design and setup guidance for the data layer — Postgres schema design, Prisma ORM patterns, Redis caching/queue patterns, and cross-ORM migration strategy (expand-contract). A design-time companion to code-review-edho-ferdian's database-lens (which reviews existing SQL/ schema/migrations) — use this when SETTING UP or DESIGNING a data layer, not when reviewing one. Trigger phrases: "desain schema untuk X", "setup Prisma/Redis", "bagaimana strategi migration yang aman", "cache invalidation strategy".
